alerts.title: Iran war live: Italy says drone in deadly Kuwait attack was made in Iran
alerts.why: Attribution of a deadly drone attack in Kuwait to Iran escalates Middle East geopolitical tensions, threatening regional crude oil supplies.

itemsSent.title: Soaring Fuel Prices Threaten to Push More Airlines Into Bankruptcy
itemsSent.why: Soaring jet fuel demand and high costs underpin middle distillates strength, though broad airline bankruptcy risks could eventually curb consumption.

itemsSent.title: Oil Context Weekly (W48)
itemsSent.why: Short covering after speculative positioning reached extremes clashed with slowing Middle Eastern exports, driving a sharp bounce in crude prices.

itemsSent.title: What the Ship: Hormuz Crisis, War Risk Spikes, Cruise Chaos, Cable Sabotage & SS United States

itemsSent.title: U.S. natural gas inventories end injection season above normal levels
itemsSent.why: Lower 48 natural gas storage ended the injection season above the five-year average, signalling ample supply heading into winter.
